description: query.rs has near-identical "# Excluded from extras preservation" + "## What to do instead" + cross-reference blocks on each of Operator (lines 20-52), Filter (lines 76-100), FilterOperator (lines 114-122). Each block is ~25-30 lines. Reader fatigue: a contributor scrolling through the file sees the same paragraphs three times before reaching the `pub enum` declarations. Suggested rewrite: keep a single comprehensive block at the module level (already exists, lines 7-14, but is much shorter than the per-type blocks); shrink each type's doc to a one-line \"# Extras: excluded (see module doc)\" pointer. The current shape is rustdoc-rendered-friendly (each type's docs page is self-contained) but at-source-level it's high noise.
title: Filter / Operator doc blocks duplicate same 30-line text 3 times in one file
